test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest city of Myanmar?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Yangon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yangon **is also known as** Rangoon **until **1989.**
 
• **Yangon** is the **Industrial and commercial **centre of the country.
 
• **Yangon** is best known for **Shwedagon Pagoda,** a sacred** Buddhist pagoda** with shimmering **gold-leaf stupas** encrusted with** precious jewels**.
 
• The language of **Yangon** is **Burmese. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naypyidaw: **

 
 
• It is the** official capital** of **Myanmar(Burma).**
 
• ​Nap-pyi-daw was built in the central basin of Myanmar in the early 21st century.
 
 
 
• **​Pathein:** 
 
 
• ​It is formerly called **Bassein,**​ is the capital of the **Ayeyarwady Region** of** Myanmar.**
 
 
 
• **Mandalay:** 
 
 
• **Mandalay** is the **second-largest **city in **Myanmar.**
